title: Not the best* Update-Save yourself time and money
text:
Not the best* Update-Save yourself time and money. It works, but does not toast evenly. Not even close. It varies from one use to the next. I purchased the warranty, so will probably return and try again. Not impressed, epic fail.
Update;
Finally broke dwn and called hamilton beach after toast is burnt on one side on second round of toast making. They happily told me it is under warranty, and that they will ship me a new one foe 11.49, the cost of shipping. I ok'd this, altho it irked me, and today (next day) there is a message on my recorder that my toaster is out of stock and to please pick another one at the same or loweer price. After going to the web site and looking, mine is the only one at that price, so they graciously tell me taht I can pay the extera to upgrade. What a JOKE! I will never buy a Hamilton Beach product again, and I am placing my experience with the product and company so that yopu can be forwarned.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach 2 Slice Cool Touch Toaster (22121),Black
features: Wide 1.5" slots fit thick bagels, waffles & hand-sliced bread
description: Make perfect toast with the Hamilton Beach PerfectToast 2-Slice Toaster. With slots wide enough for bagels, waffles, and hand sliced bread and an automatic toast boost function, this toaster can fit all of your family's toasting needs.
